text: Added a reader-first alpha guide covering GraphSample, lawful WL composition, prepared views, query alignment and novel norm, reference-bound centering, shortest-path features/provenance, fingerprint blockers, plan reports, and typed recovery paths. Added examplesJVM with one executable walkthrough and 2/2 tests; runMain output is recorded in the guide. Editorial review exposed and documents the current WL source-provenance API gap without overstating capabilities.
